words.example: Penetrating nail oil soaks into the nail to keep it flexible.
words.exampleTranslation: 渗透型指甲营养油会渗进指甲，让指甲保持柔韧。

evidence.quote: Nail oils (NAYL OYLZ) are designed to be absorbed into the nail plate to increase flexibility
suggest professional products designed to penetrate the natural and enhanced nail to keep it flexible: penetrating nail oils.

words.example: Nail bleach works best on surface stains, like tobacco.
words.exampleTranslation: 指甲漂白剂对表面污渍效果最好，例如烟渍。

evidence.quote: These products work best for surface stains (e.g., tobacco).
you can bleach them with a nail bleach product designed specifically for this purpose.

words.example: Bevel the underside of the free edge at a 45-degree angle.
words.exampleTranslation: 以 45 度角给游离缘的下侧倒斜边。

evidence.quote: Bevel the underside of the nail by holding a medium-grit abrasive board at a 45-degree angle to the underside of the nail

words.example: A squoval nail has a square free edge with rounded corners.
words.exampleTranslation: 方圆形指甲的游离缘是方的，两个角是圆的。

evidence.quote: has a square free edge that is rounded off at the corner edges.

words.example: An oval nail is like squoval, with even rounder corners.
words.exampleTranslation: 椭圆形指甲像方圆形，但两个角更圆。

evidence.quote: It is similar to a squoval nail, with corners that are even more rounded.

words.example: Oval is a conservative shape, thought to look good on most hands.
words.exampleTranslation: 椭圆形是一种保守的甲形，被认为适合大多数人的手。

evidence.quote: The oval nail (OH-vul NAYL) is a conservative shape thought to be attractive on most hands.

words.example: A stiletto nail is long and pointed, and may break more easily.
words.exampleTranslation: 尖形（stiletto）指甲又长又尖，比较容易断。

evidence.quote: The pointed nail (POYNT-ed NAYL) or stiletto nail (stih-LET-toe NAYL) is tapered and longer than usual
this nail shape may be weaker, may break more easily

words.example: Buff the nails to smooth out scratches and give them shine.
words.exampleTranslation: 抛光指甲，磨平划痕，让指甲有光泽。

evidence.quote: Use a buffer to smooth out surface scratches and give the natural nail a brilliant shine.
buff the nails with a high-shine buffer.

words.example: A waterless manicure has no water soak for the nails.
words.exampleTranslation: 无水修手不用水浸泡指甲。

evidence.quote: Waterless manicures eliminate soaking the nails in water

words.example: Lotion and heated mitts can soften the skin instead of water.
words.exampleTranslation: 可以用乳液和电热手套代替水来软化皮肤。

evidence.quote: some nail technicians use lotion and heated mitts instead to soften the skin and cuticles.

words.example: In effleurage, the hands glide over the skin.
words.exampleTranslation: 做轻抚法时，双手在皮肤上滑动。

evidence.quote: is a succession of strokes in which the hands glide over an area of the body with varying degrees of pressure or contact.

words.example: Pétrissage means kneading: you lift, squeeze, and press.
words.exampleTranslation: 揉捏法就是揉：抓起、挤压、按下。

evidence.quote: or kneading, is lifting, squeezing, and pressing the tissue.

words.example: Tapotement is fast tapping with the hands on the skin.
words.exampleTranslation: 叩击法是用手在皮肤上快速拍打。

evidence.quote: is a rapid tapping or striking motion of the hands against the skin.

words.example: In vibration, the hand shakes but never leaves the skin.
words.exampleTranslation: 振动法中，手一直抖动，但不离开皮肤。

evidence.quote: is a continuous trembling or shaking movement applied by the hand without leaving contact with the skin.

words.example: Friction rubs or presses one layer of tissue over another.
words.exampleTranslation: 摩擦法是把一层组织在另一层上搓动或按压。

evidence.quote: incorporates various strokes that manipulate or press one layer of tissue over another.
friction massage movement that is a deep rubbing action.

words.example: The goal of massage in a manicure is relaxation.
words.exampleTranslation: 修手中按摩的目的是让顾客放松。

evidence.quote: the focus of a massage performed during a manicure or pedicure is purely relaxation.

words.example: Do not use vigorous, strong massage on clients with arthritis.
words.exampleTranslation: 顾客有关节炎时，不要用剧烈、用力的按摩手法。

evidence.quote: Avoid performing vigorous or strong massage techniques on clients who have arthritis.

words.example: Arthritis can make joints painful. Never press right on the joints.
words.exampleTranslation: 关节炎会让关节疼痛。绝不要直接按压关节。

evidence.quote: There are many reasons a client may have painful joints, the most well-known reason being arthritis.
handle them gently, never applying pressure directly on the joints.

words.example: Skin drag happens when there is too little lotion on the skin.
words.exampleTranslation: 皮肤上的乳液太少时，就会出现皮肤拖拽。

evidence.quote: Apply enough to allow movement across the skin without resistance (such resistance is known as skin drag).
Skin drag is not comfortable for the client.

words.example: Feathering off is the light stroke that ends the massage.
words.exampleTranslation: 羽毛式收尾是结束按摩时的轻柔手法。

evidence.quote: with a light-as-a-feather touch, pull your fingers from the back of the hands down the fingers and off the tips of the fingers.
This final movement, called feathering off, is the end of the massage.

words.example: Hold the foot firmly. A light, loose hold can feel ticklish.
words.exampleTranslation: 要稳稳地握住脚。握得太轻太松会让人觉得痒。

evidence.quote: Avoid holding the foot lightly or loosely, as it can cause a ticklish sensation in many people.

words.example: A callus is thick skin that protects the skin under it.
words.exampleTranslation: 老茧是一层厚皮，保护下面的皮肤。

evidence.quote: Continued, repeated pressure on any part of the skin can cause it to thicken and develop into a callus
Remember that calluses are there for a reason: They protect the underlying skin from irritation.

words.example: An ingrown toenail grows into the skin beside the nail.
words.exampleTranslation: 嵌甲就是脚趾甲长进旁边的皮肤里。

evidence.quote: to reduce the sides of the free edge that might grow into the tissues and potentially cause an ingrown nail.

words.example: A podiatrist is a foot doctor who can treat ingrown nails.
words.exampleTranslation: 足科医生是看脚的医生，可以治疗嵌甲。

evidence.quote: Caring for ingrown or infected nails is a medical treatment and must be performed by a physician or podiatrist.
refer clients with ingrown nails to a podiatrist.

words.example: Never use a razor-type callus shaver. Calluses grow back heavier.
words.exampleTranslation: 绝不要用剃刀式去茧刀。老茧会长得更厚。

evidence.quote: The use of a razor-type callus shaver also stimulates heavier growth of calluses later
When a client comes in with heavy calluses, never use a razor-type callus shaver.

words.example: Tremors are shaking movements that a client cannot control.
words.exampleTranslation: 颤抖是顾客控制不住的抖动。

evidence.quote: you may notice that they have tremors or involuntary movement, which may indicate a neurological issue.

words.example: Exfoliate the foot with a scrub to remove dry, scaly skin.
words.exampleTranslation: 用磨砂膏给脚去角质，去掉干燥脱屑的皮肤。

evidence.quote: Exfoliate the foot with a scrub to remove the dry or scaly skin.

words.example: Do not use metal pushers on clients with a chronic illness.
words.exampleTranslation: 顾客有慢性病时，不要用金属推棒。

evidence.quote: Do not use metal pushers or sharp implements on clients who have any chronic illnesses.

words.example: Soak with a urea softener before cleaning buildup between toes.
words.exampleTranslation: 清理脚趾间的积垢前，先用含尿素的软化产品浸泡。

evidence.quote: be sure to soak the nails longer with a softening product containing urea before trying to clean between them.

words.example: Microtrauma is tiny, unseen openings in the skin, like shaving scrapes.
words.exampleTranslation: 微创伤是皮肤上看不见的细小开口，例如刮腿毛留下的刮痕。

evidence.quote: Microtrauma is the act of causing tiny unseen openings in the skin that may allow pathogenic microbes to enter.
Invisible shaving scrapes, also known as microtrauma

words.example: A spa pedicure takes longer and includes a leg massage.
words.exampleTranslation: 水疗修脚时间更长，还包括腿部按摩。

evidence.quote: a spa pedicure is usually one hour to one hour and a half and includes the leg massage

words.example: Scaly feet may mean fungus, so a podiatrist must check first.
words.exampleTranslation: 脚部脱屑可能是真菌感染，所以必须先让足科医生检查。

evidence.quote: First, however, the client must visit a podiatrist to determine whether the feet are fungal; fungus can present as a scaly condition on the feet.

words.example: In a dry pedicure, you still shape the nails and apply lotion.
words.exampleTranslation: 做干式修脚时，你照样要修甲形、涂乳液。

evidence.quote: During a dry pedicure, you will still shorten and shape the nails, clean the cuticles, and gently apply lotion.

words.example: A base coat stops stains and helps colored polish stick.
words.exampleTranslation: 底油能防止染色，并帮助彩色甲油附着。

evidence.quote: Apply a base coat to keep the polish from staining the nails and to help colored polish adhere to the nail plate.

words.example: The three-stroke method uses one stroke down the middle, one each side.
words.exampleTranslation: 三笔涂法是中间往下涂一笔，两侧各涂一笔。

evidence.quote: Professional nail technicians practice the three-stroke method.
Apply one light stroke of polish down the middle and one on each side of the nail.

words.example: Capping seals the free edge with polish and reduces chipping.
words.exampleTranslation: 包边就是用甲油封住游离缘，减少剥落。

evidence.quote: This is called tip sealing, or capping, and it reduces chipping and layering on the free edges.

words.example: Start with the dominant hand, the hand the client uses most.
words.exampleTranslation: 先从惯用手开始，也就是顾客最常用的那只手。

evidence.quote: Apply a thin layer of base coat on the entire plate of the nails on the dominant hand.
This will give the most-used hand a head start in drying and reduce the likelihood of smudging.

words.example: A traditional French manicure often has a pink nail and white tip.
words.exampleTranslation: 传统法式美甲通常是粉色指甲配白色指尖。

evidence.quote: the nail bed is one color—such as pink, peach, or beige (depending upon the client’s skin tone)—and the free edge of the nail is another color, such as white.

words.example: The smile line is the curve where the pink and white meet.
words.exampleTranslation: 微笑线是粉色和白色交界的那条弧线。

evidence.quote: The curved line where the pink and the white meet on the nail is called the smile line

words.example: Marbleizing swirls wet colors together with a stylus.
words.exampleTranslation: 大理石纹是用点花笔把未干的几种颜色搅成漩涡。

evidence.quote: is a swirled effect created when you combine two or more colors while they are wet and then mix them on
the nail with a tool known as a stylus.

words.example: A stylus has a round ball tip on each end.
words.exampleTranslation: 点花笔的两端各有一个圆球头。

evidence.quote: has a solid handle with a rounded ball tip on each end that can range in size.

words.example: A paraffin wax treatment traps moisture in the skin.
words.exampleTranslation: 蜡疗能把水分锁在皮肤里。

evidence.quote: wax treatments are designed to trap moisture in the skin

words.example: Avoid paraffin for clients with impaired circulation (poor blood flow).
words.exampleTranslation: 血液循环不良（血流不好）的顾客，要避免做蜡疗。

evidence.quote: Avoid paraffin treatments on clients who have impaired circulation
The heat from the warm paraffin increases blood circulation to the skin.

words.example: Test heat tolerance with a small patch of wax on the skin.
words.exampleTranslation: 在皮肤上滴一小片蜡，测试顾客的耐热度。

evidence.quote: A test for heat tolerance is performed on all clients the first time they have the service.
Drop a patch of wax about 1” (2.5 cm) in diameter on the client’s skin to see if the temperatures can be tolerated.

words.example: In a hot stone pedicure, the stones are warm, not hot.
words.exampleTranslation: 热石修脚中，石头是温暖的，并不烫。

evidence.quote: the stones are not hot, they are merely comfortably warm.
Hot stone pedicures are an upscale service included in the massage of the feet and legs.

meaning.zh: 前端是方的，两角稍微修圆

meaning.zh: 两角很圆；被认为适合大多数人的手

evidence.quote: is completely straight across the free edge, with no rounding at the outside edges.
has a square free edge that is rounded off at the corner edges.

is a conservative shape thought to be attractive on most hands.

fast tapping or striking with the hands

meaning.zh: 抖动，手始终不离开皮肤

tip.zh: vibration（振动法）：像手机在手里震动，一直不离手。friction（摩擦法）：双手快速对搓，会发热。

evidence.quote: is a continuous trembling or shaking movement applied by the hand without leaving contact with the skin.
incorporates various strokes that manipulate or press one layer of tissue over another.
friction massage movement that is a deep rubbing action.

meaning.zh: 30 到 45 分钟，只有足部按摩
1 到 1.5 小时，加腿部按摩

tip.en: Think spa day: more time, more treats. A spa pedicure adds the leg massage. Basic: foot massage only.
tip.zh: 想想“水疗日”：时间更长、享受更多。spa pedicure（水疗修脚）多了腿部按摩；basic（基础修脚）只有足部按摩。

evidence.quote: The basic pedicure in most salons is 30 to 45 minutes and does not include a leg massage, only a foot massage
a spa pedicure is usually one hour to one hour and a half and includes the leg massage

meaning.en: brushing polish on the very tip
meaning.zh: 把甲油刷在指甲最前端

meaning.en: pressing the brush so the bristles spread
filing the underside of the free edge

tip.en: Cap the tip, like a pen cap. Fan the brush, like a hand fan. Bevel uses a file, not polish.
tip.zh: capping：像笔帽一样“盖住”指尖。fanning：刷毛散开像扇子。beveling 用锉板，不用甲油。中文也提示：包边、扇形压刷、倒斜边。

evidence.quote: move the brush back and forth on the very end of the free edge, barely touching it, to apply color. This is called tip sealing, or capping
Lightly press the brush onto the nail plate, producing a slight fanning of the brush
Bevel the underside of the nail by holding a medium-grit abrasive board at a 45-degree angle to the underside of the nail

meaning.zh: 用点花笔把未干的颜色搅成漩涡
一种颜色渐渐过渡到另一种

meaning.zh: 指甲上一块块或一条条的颜色

tip.en: Picture a marble floor: swirls. Color blocking: blocks, like toy blocks. Ombre is the one that fades.
tip.zh: 想象大理石地板：有漩涡纹，就是 marbleizing。color blocking 就是“色块”，像积木。剩下会渐变的就是 ombre。
